Equals(Block)

Indicates whether the current object is equal to another object of the same type.

public override bool Equals(Block thatBlock)

Parameters

thatBlock Block

The Block to compare with the current object.

Returns

bool

true if the current object is equal to the thatBlock parameter; otherwise, false.

Remarks

Equality is determined by checking:

  1. if thatBlock is null (always false)
  2. type
  3. the number of tiles in the block
  4. the actual tiles in the block (after sorting)

GetHashCodeBasis()

Get the hash code basis representing this block type, which will be exponentiated as a part of calculating GetHashCode().

public static int GetHashCodeBasis()

Returns

int

The basis to use when calculating hash codes for this block type.

Remarks

The number returned here should be a unique prime number among all derived Koffing.Blocks to ensure proper hashing. The current set of numbers is verified in GetBlockHashCodeIsCorrect(Block, int).
